# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RSI_DIVERGENCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-08-18  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bullish RSI divergence while price holds above VWAP signals latent buying pressure leading to upward continuation. This edge exists because VWAP acts as dynamic support/resistance and RSI divergence indicates weakening momentum despite price action, often preceding mean-reversion or trend resumption in choppy/low-trend regimes (VIX 12-22) after 11:00 ET when intraday trends develop.

## Mechanism

Entry: When price closes above VWAP for two consecutive bars AND RSI(14) makes a higher low while price makes a lower low (bullish RSI divergence) within the last 5 bars, go long at the close of the second bar.  
Exit: Chart-stop at recent swing low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 2R (measured from entry to stop), runner trail 20% off HWM (high-water mark) after TP1 hit.

2. **Sample bias:** Zero-sample proposal; no historical backtest conducted. High overfit risk from unvalidated indicator combination (VWAP + RSI divergence) and regime-specific assumptions (VIX 12-22, post-11:00 ET).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested)

5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Whipsaw: false VWAP close + RSI divergence in choppy markets causing immediate reversal
   - Regime mismatch: ineffective in high-VIX (>25) or low-VIX (<12) environments
   - Timing failure: signals occurring pre-11:00 ET lacking intraday trend follow-through
   - Exit slippage: chart-stop invalidation missed during fast moves, runner trail too tight in volatile regimes
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days drive >50% of P&L (typical for novel triggers)
